name: pregame
description: PreGame - Saufspiel-App mit Kumpel-Charakter, als natives iOS-Projekt via Capacitor verpackt

scripts.build:ranking: npx esbuild src/ranking/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=PreGameRankingBundle --outfile=www/ranking.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='www/ranking.js'; let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!s.includes('window.PreGameRanking')) s+='\nwindow.PreGameRanking=PreGameRankingBundle.default||PreGameRankingBundle;\n'; fs.writeFileSync(p,s);"
scripts.prepare-www: mkdir -p www && cp saufapp.html www/index.html && cp manifest.json www/manifest.json && rm -rf www/assets && cp -R assets www/assets && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/capacitor.js && cp node_modules/@aparajita/capacitor-secure-storage/dist/plugin.js www/secure-storage.js && npm run build:ranking
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync ios
